Patreon members get project files, early and ad-free videos, my custom finish, behind the scenes videos, as well as access to our private Discord: https://www.patreon.com/picciuto

Getting rid of tools I thought I needed. Over the years I’ve collected tools, materials, jigs, and “someday” upcycle projects faster than I can actually make, and it’s turned into too much stuff, too many choices, and too many decisions. This video is about reclaiming your shop and your brain by letting go of what you haven’t used in years, sorting what’s trash, donate, or sell, and being honest about what “potential” has quietly become weight. Some things are harder to let go than others, but if it’s been sitting for years, it’s time to make space for what I actually want to build now.
